sources.title: EPA Ultraviolet Disinfection Guidance Manual, EPA815-R-06-007, November 2006
sources.scope: Engineered UV treatment-credit doses and surrogate identification, not environmental sunlight decay.

sources.title: EPA Recreational Water Quality Criteria, EPA 820-F-12-058
sources.scope: E. coli as fecal indicator, not a conversion to pathogen concentration.

sources.title: EPA Method 1623: Cryptosporidium and Giardia in Water by Filtration/IMS/FA, December 2005
sources.scope: Enumerates detected oocysts/cysts; does not determine viability or infectivity.

sources.title: EPA Water Quality Analysis Simulation Program
sources.scope: Hydrodynamic and sediment transport coupling; no site-specific microbial coefficients supplied.

sources.title: USACE HEC-ResSim Water Quality, Appendix A: Technical Background
sources.scope: Temperature, light, settling/resuspension process structure; not calibrated Angkor rates.

presets.name: Escherichia coli (fecal indicator)
presets.stage: vegetative cells; culturable-equivalent inventory if CFU-calibrated
presets.role: Fecal indicator; no assumption of pathogenic strain or fixed pathogen ratio.
presets.calibration_status: All environmental rates unset. Every process disabled until user supplies explicit coefficients.
presets.growth_note: Optional growth is a user-calibrated exploratory model, disabled by default.

presets.name: Cryptosporidium spp.
presets.role: Viability-equivalent oocysts; infectivity needs separate calibration and assay.
presets.calibration_status: All environmental rates unset. Every process disabled until user supplies explicit coefficients.
presets.growth_note: No growth of this transported dormant stage. Germination/host lifecycle not represented.

engineered_uv_reference.scope: Regulatory treatment-credit requirements for applicable drinking-water UV systems; not experimental natural-sunlight kinetics; not automatically used by model.
